run_infer_posterior_samples: run inference on queries with observations to get MonteCarloSamples from the posterior distribution
create_sampler_generator: create a sampler generator that yields new world states for each iteration of the inference graph
run_parallel_inference_chains: run multiple inference chains in parallel using multiprocessing with fork or spawn context
review_get_proposers_abstract: review the abstract get_proposers method that subclasses must implement to return proposers for target random variables
test_single_chain_infer: test a single chain of inference to collect samples and log likelihoods for queries and observations
